{"failure_class": "closing step skipped",
 "root_cause": "The agent made the main update and finished. The request ended with a closing step, a post in the Slack channel it named, and the agent's last message says nothing in its instructions covers closing steps of this kind. The only failed check is the Slack message.",
 "mechanism": "A working note that tells the agent: when a request ends by asking to post a message in a Slack channel, make that post in the named channel with the given text before finishing.",
 "component": "memory",
 "generality": "Every request that ends with a closing channel post hits the same gap, and the agent says its instructions lack this kind of closing step."}
